+++ b/shadow_pr_arena_mcp/__init__.py
@@ -1,3 +1,21 @@
 """Shadow PR Arena MCP package."""
 
-__version__ = "0.1.0"
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def _get_version() -> str:
+    """Read version from pyproject.toml."""
+    try:
+        import tomllib
+    except ModuleNotFoundError:
+        import tomli as tomllib
+
+    pyproject = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "pyproject.toml"
+    if pyproject.exists():
+        with open(pyproject, "rb") as f:
+            data = tomllib.load(f)
+        return data.get("project", {}).get("version", "0.0.0-dev")
+    return "0.0.0-dev"
+
+
+__version__ = _get_version()

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_cli.py
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+import shadow_pr_arena_mcp as package
+from shadow_pr_arena_mcp.cli import main
+
+
+def test_get_version_reads_pyproject_from_package_root(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    package_dir = tmp_path / "shadow_pr_arena_mcp"
+    package_dir.mkdir()
+    (tmp_path / "pyproject.toml").write_text('[project]\nversion = "9.8.7"\n', encoding="utf-8")
+    fake_init = package_dir / "__init__.py"
+    fake_init.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(package, "__file__", str(fake_init))
+
+    assert package._get_version() == "9.8.7"
+
+
+def test_main_prints_version_from_package(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]):
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as excinfo:
+        main(["--version"])
+
+    assert excinfo.value.code == 0
+    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == f"shadow-pr-arena {package.__version__}"
